description: Governed entry point for Vermont licensed center-program acquisition and offline normalization.
redirect_policy: Fixed anonymous official Vermont catalog, aggregate, roster and selected-field SODA2 GET endpoints; redirects rejected and retained mode makes no network requests.
retry: No automatic source retries, authenticated SODA3 use, endpoint fallback or job restart. Preserve completed acquisitions for explicit offline reuse.
checkpoint: Persist paired preflight, three traversals, start, verified child releases and terminal receipt; independently replay and atomically advance the governed pointer last.
idempotency: Immutable UUID releases; retained inputs avoid repulling, historical releases are not overwritten, and failed runs preserve the prior pointer.
cancellation: Abort transport and pacing, drain writers, retain completed child evidence, and inspect uncertain ownership.
retention_profile: Internal center-only source candidates and immutable receipts. ZIP5 and ZIP4 remain separate; jittered points are excluded; missing geography remains explicit; no business polygons or public record export.
